items.title: CFTC approves individual stock perpetual futures trading in US for the first time
items.summary: The CFTC approved the ability for exchanges in the U.S. to offer perpetual futures contracts tied to individual stocks.

items.title: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, September 2026
items.summary: The U.S. goods and services trade deficit decreased in September 2026 according to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and the U.S. Census Bureau. The deficit decreased from $105.7 billion in August (revised) to $105.0 billion in September, as exports increased more than imports. The goods deficit decreased $0.7 billion in September to $135.9 billion. The services surplus decreased less than $0.1
